name: theme-high-contrast
title: Byterygon theme: high-contrast
description: High contrast: WCAG 2.2 AAA (7:1 text, 4.5:1 for controls and focus), pure grey neutral, a deep blue accent and a thick focus ring. Comfortable density. Installs the --by-* token variables (Light/Dark via data-theme or .dark, Comfortable/Compact via data-density), the shadcn/ui variable aliases and the Tailwind names of the roles. Fonts are not included: copy @byterygon/design-tokens/fonts and import fonts.css for Inter and JetBrains Mono, or the system fallbacks are used.
